name: Coordinator Responds Directly to User
description:
Fires when a coordinator loop calls decide(action=respond_direct, reason=<user-facing prose>). The persona contract overloads `reason` for this action: it carries the prose intended for the user, NOT an internal log. This rule stamps coordinator.clarification.reply for audit. Typed response delivery is owned by agentic-dispatch; beta.161 reserves user.response.> for agentic.user_response/v1 and this rule deliberately has no flat publish action. Dispatch currently carries the structured decide result in UserResponse.Content; channel-ready extraction of `reason` is tracked in semstreams#1090.

Fires for both front-door direct responses and chain-terminal wake-up responses. The audit shape is identical for both; the wake-up coordinator's reason is the synthesized answer.

metadata.delivery_contract: agentic-dispatch owns typed agentic.user_response/v1 delivery and currently carries the structured decide result in UserResponse.Content. This rule owns only the response audit triple and must not publish a flat rule envelope into user.response.>. Channel-ready reason extraction is semstreams#1090.
metadata.reason_overload_note: Persona contract (10-decision-contract.md) overloads `reason` for action=respond_direct to carry user-facing prose, parallel to action=ask_user. The wake-up coordinator (spawned by 04a-/04b-) writes its synthesised chain-result answer in `reason`; the front-door coordinator (handling small-talk or simple answers) does the same. Slice 1c is when respond_direct's `reason` becomes user-facing — Slice 1 left it on the floor.
metadata.audit_triple_distinction: coordinator.clarification.reply is the audit triple for respond_direct prose; coordinator.clarification.question is the audit triple for ask_user prose.
